messages:
Jamie: Quick heads-up — ran a warm-KV + spinup-batcher sweep on mixtral-8x with AWQ/INT8 profiles. Seeing intermittent 95th/99th tail spikes when RoPE scale > 1.0, especially on long-context traces. Summary attached below.

Sam: Can you paste the perf summary and the exact runner flags?

Jamie: Yup. Command we used: `./run_infer --model=mixtral-8x --quant=awq --kernel_selector=auto --batcher=warm-spin --kv-warmup=4 --rope-scale=1.2 --microbatch=2`

Jamie: Perf excerpt (p99 ms): base(rope=1.0) 24ms, rope=1.2 -> 58ms (spike on token 1->5 after warmup), p95 32ms->45ms. CPU/GPU timelines show kernel switch around second decode step.

Anitha: Interesting — AWQ int8 path triggers a different matmul kernel for head_dim alignment. If RoPE scaling changes sequence math we could be hitting an unaligned codepath that disables continuous batching.

Lee: Do we have KV cache occupancy traces? Could be that warm-spin batches are evicting/rehydrating kv shards and causing short-term serialization.

Jamie: KV occupancy: after warmup we keep ~85% hotset in L2, but a thin tail (~5%) gets loaded on demand. I attached a short flame: `kernel_dispatch -> matmul_headwise_awq_int8 -> kv_fetch -> fallback_gemm` repeated in the spike window.

Sam: Is this repro on GPTQ? Try the same config with `--quant=gptq` and `--kernel_selector=force_gemm` to see if the kernel selection is the factor.

Jamie: Quick test: `--quant=gptq` + `force_gemm` gives p99 29ms (much better), p95 28ms. So AWQ + auto-selector seems to pick an int8 headwise kernel that thrashes batching.

Anitha: That matches theory. AWQ calibration prompts matter too — the calibration set we used was short conversational prompts; headwise scaling skew can cause per-head quant scales that break vectorized kernels. Try calibration with long-sequence wiki-ish prompts and compare accuracy delta.

Jamie: Did a calibration swap: conversational->wiki. Accuracy delta: AWQ conv-calib top-1 drop ~0.8% vs wiki-calib drop ~0.2%. Performance wise wiki-calib reduced kernel-switch churn and p99 improved to ~34ms.

Lee: Nice. Action items: 1) Add a kernel-selector rule to avoid int8 headwise kernel when rope_scale != 1.0 or when microbatch>1. 2) Add a KV warmset prefetch threshold to keep that 5% tail resident during spinup. 3) Run AWQ calibration comparison job across Mistral/Mixtral/Qwen families with both conv/wiki prompts.

Sam: I'll open a runtime ticket and mark as regression if we find this behavior on stable deploys.

deploy-bot: ticket INF-4821 created: "mixtral warm-kv spinup -> AWQ kernel churn / rope-scale perf regression" assigned to eng-runtime.

Jamie: tagging @Lee for follow-up perf traces and @Anitha for quant calibs. Will stash full traces in /mnt/perf/2398765432/ and link in the ticket. :thumbsup:
